verification.note: migrated from data/antibiogram-raw.json: extracted from the source PDF, then re-verified cell by cell by a second reader (2026)

notes: Cureus 2024 (16(9):e69525), Sammal et al., Govt Doon Medical College, Dehradun; CSOM middle-ear pus, VITEK-2 / CLSI. Susceptibility tables read from PDF text (Tables 2-4, pages 5-6). Source prints Sensitive/Intermediate/Resistant as counts and %; I extracted %Sensitive only (I% NOT added). Total 129 culture-positive isolates. Only P. aeruginosa (Table 2) and S. aureus (Table 3) had full antibiograms; MRSA had a separate table (Table 4) but maps to the same canonical S. aureus so is listed in unmapped rather than merged. MRSA context: 18 MRSA + 23 S. aureus isolates => MRSA ~43.9% of all S. aureus (13.1% of 137 total cases / of 129 positives). AST denominators vary slightly by drug (e.g. piptazo n=38, ceftazidime n=45, imipenem n=44) but % taken exactly as printed. Amikacin for P. aeruginosa (57.8%) is from Discussion narrative, not Table 2.

notes.amikacin: reported in Discussion text (57.8%, 26 isolates), not in Table 2
